proves.claim: On a real temp repo, an accepted item whose only conflict with main is mechanical shows as verified and not stale in pullboard show and pullboard list.

cli.journeys-verify-mechanical-conflict..why: Without it, show and list would call an accept stale that landing treats as fresh, so a reviewer would redo work the board lands.

proves.claim: On a real temp repo, a real source conflict still shows STALE_VERDICT naming the file in pullboard show and pullboard list.

cli.journeys-verify-mechanical-conflict..why: Without it, the mechanical port could hide a real conflict from show and list.
